requirements.desc: After finalize-cleanup resolves the target worktree, cleanup-time flow state, metrics, notes, issue-log, runtime-derived, and plugin artifact writes must not create or modify files under that target worktree.
requirements.note: R1: cleanup write policy relocates flow and plugin artifact writes away from target worktree

requirements.desc: Retained finalize-cleanup surfaces must still be persisted or reported through the main repository FlowManager/FlowStore before the final flow.json commit, or through a durable non-worktree sidecar/runtime log for dispatcher and agent metadata produced after that commit.
requirements.note: R2: retained finalize-cleanup surfaces have durable owners outside the removable worktree

requirements.desc: After the final flow.json snapshot is committed during finalize-cleanup, dispatcher-owned runtimeLog completion and agent metric writes must not mutate the committed flow.json; they must persist to target-worktree-external durable storage.
requirements.note: R6: post-command runtime and metric metadata use sidecar storage instead of final flow.json

requirements.desc: `senti flow run finalize-cleanup --force` must call git worktree removal with force semantics for dirty root files and initialized submodule dirty state caused by external factors.
requirements.note: R3: forced finalize-cleanup removal passes --force to git worktree remove for dirty worktrees

requirements.desc: Spec-local regression tests must cover cleanup-time metrics append relocation, retained public finalize-cleanup surfaces, normal worktree removal, feature branch deletion, and dirty worktree force removal.
requirements.note: R4: regression hooks cover read-only cleanup and force-removal scenarios

requirements.desc: Existing finalize-cleanup report warnings, plugin hook warning/follow-up data, and recovery envelopes must remain available to callers after write relocation.
requirements.note: R5: report and plugin hook outputs remain observable through durable cleanup owners
